title: AvAI
description: This mod replaces the conventional Minecraft objective system with a basic decision tree.
body:
# AvAI

AvAI replaces Minecraft default mob AI system with a decision tree–based approach, aiming to create more dynamic and context-aware behavior.

## Features
- Replaces vanilla goal-based AI with a decision tree system
- Experimental environment-based decision making
- Multi-threaded AI processing

## Current State
This mod is in an early experimental stage.

Some intended behaviors (such as mobs reacting properly to environmental conditions like sunlight) are **not fully implemented yet** and may not work as expected.

## Important
- Expect bugs and incomplete features  
- Requires a CPU with multiple cores due to multi-threading  
- May conflict with other mods that modify mob AI (e.g., Lithium)

## Compatibility
- Minecraft version: 1.21.11
- Mod loader: Fabric  
- Known incompatibilities:
  - Mods that heavily modify mob AI  

## Notes
- This project is experimental  
- Feedback is welcome!
